entry.title: New: Resolution 527 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE WAIMEA HAWAIIAN HOMESTEADERS ASSOCIATION INC. TO PURCHASE A BRONZE PLAQUE FOR THE JAMES “JIMMY” CORREA BALLFIELD AT DR. FRANCIS F. C. WONG STADIUM

Transfers $3,883 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 3)

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 527-24, Draft 2 - 06/05/24
